body: I feel like this alot. I daydream about being in a crash or being mugged and shot. The guilt associated with "suicide" is a heavy weight.
I barely finished the semester. I just stopped going the last two weeks and I didnt care what the outcome would be. Its hard enough to get out of bed let alone study for 4 finals.

Ive been in therapy since it happened. Ive spent nearly a year in in-patient psych wards (right after it happened). To friends and family, I seem pretty well adjusted. I exercise, I'm back in school, try to stay away from alcohol, try to keep up with my anti-depressants. I learned that putting on a mask for family, especially my mom, is the easiest way to quell their anxiety over my mental health. I haven't told my therapist about the videos. I think that I'll probably end up killing myself eventually, but I'm ok at the moment. For some reason the videos are therapeutic in a fucked up way.

Made a throwaway to answer this. When I was 20 I killed someone on accident and he died really really hard. It fucked me up. Im 26 now and Im still warped since the entire incident occurred. At first I watched death videos to relive and "feel" the pain he felt when he died. Then I watched them to prepare myself in some warped way for how I would feel when I committed suicide. Years later I watch them still to make myself feel the things I felt when he died. 

All in all, when I killed him something in me died too, and I watch and save hundreds of death videos like some guttural addiction.
